title: Tamoz
name: Ruby-Native Durable Agent Framework
summary: A Ruby-native durable agent framework for checkpointed, interruptible, observable, and evaluation-governed AI workflows.
problem: Agent frameworks often move quickly on demos while leaving durability, review boundaries, evaluation evidence, and failure recovery as afterthoughts.
outcome: Tamoz is building core runtime protocols, deterministic graph execution, SQLite durability, a RubyLLM agent runtime, and an evaluation harness as independently publishable gems.

title: ALMS
name: Agent Learning Management System
summary: A self-hosted MCP server that gives autonomous agents shared operational memory without turning into an orchestration framework.
problem: Agent fleets repeatedly rediscover the same failure modes because useful learnings stay trapped inside individual runs.
outcome: Agents can register, publish learnings, sync new knowledge, and pull operational protocols by tag while continuing to work if ALMS is offline.

title: SkillLedger
name: Agent Skill Marketplace Ledger
summary: A Rails API for agent-to-agent skill publishing, discovery, purchase, and settlement with a local database-backed ledger.
problem: Agent skills need quality incentives and an auditable execution economy before they can be reused safely across independent agents.
outcome: Authors stake credits, buyers purchase executions, failures slash the author stake, and every transfer is recorded as immutable ledger entries.

title: Film Pipeline
name: LangGraph Film Creation Pipeline
summary: An MIT-licensed LangGraph film pipeline that moves an idea through approved artifacts, generation planning, QC evidence, and validated handoff state.
problem: Generative film workflows collapse when creative artifacts, approvals, revisions, costs, provider failures, and QC evidence are handled as loose files and chat history.
outcome: The pipeline exposes typed state, interrupt-based human gates, versioned artifacts, MCP tools, parallel validators, and checkpoints so production state stays inspectable.

title: Email Intelligence
name: Local-First Email Knowledge Base
summary: A local-first email intelligence platform that turns Maildir into a continuously enriched SQLite knowledge base for MCP agents.
problem: Raw IMAP access gives agents messages, but not durable knowledge, action state, semantic search, or safe write-back.
outcome: Agents query summaries, facts, decisions, threads, semantic matches, daily digests, drafts, and an append-only event feed from one local store.
